Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 1
 Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified who “Prince Napoléon Bonaparte” refers to. “Prince Napoléon” is the formal title of Napoléon Joseph Charles Paul Bonaparte (1822–1891), whose father is Jérôme Bonaparte, born 15 November 1784. Instead, the Planner steered the search toward Napoleon I (and other ambiguous possibilities), leading the process to Carlo Buonaparte and an incorrect father’s birthday.
